columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Evaluation date of the signal: month-end of the month it fired (30-Sep-2026 for the current month).
columns.name: signal_date

columns.comment: EWS trigger fired (join to gold.dim_ews_trigger): UTIL_HIGH (utilisation >= 90%, a.k.a. UTILISATION_GT_90), UTIL_ELEVATED, COV_HEADROOM_LOW (covenant headroom < 10%, a.k.a. COVENANT_HEADROOM_LT_10), COV_BREACH (covenant breach), DEPOSIT_OUTFLOW, DEPOSIT_OUTFLOW_SEVERE (deposit outflow >= 25% MoM), WALLET_LEAKAGE, HEALTH_DECLINE, GRADE_DOWNGRADE, NEWS_NEGATIVE (negative news sentiment), DPD_15, DPD_30.
columns.name: trigger_code

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Credit obligor record whose evaluation fired the trigger (the strongest one when the client has duplicate credit records).
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Credit obligor records of the client for which the trigger fired that month (normally 1).
columns.name: n_obligors_fired

columns.comment: First day of the month the trigger fired.
columns.name: signal_month

columns.comment: Trigger name, e.g. Facility utilisation >= 90%.
columns.name: trigger_name

columns.comment: Trigger category: Credit, Liquidity, Behavioural or External.
columns.name: trigger_category

columns.comment: Business family of the trigger: Utilisation, Covenant, Deposit Outflow, Wallet Leakage, Credit Health, Internal Rating, Adverse News or Payment Arrears.
columns.name: trigger_family

columns.comment: Severity of the firing: High, Medium or Low.
columns.name: severity

columns.comment: Data quadrant: Internal Quantitative (credit, liquidity, behaviour data) or External Qualitative (news).
columns.name: source_quadrant

columns.comment: Observed value that fired the trigger: utilisation fraction, covenant headroom fraction, MoM deposit change (negative), leakage share, health drop, notches, days past due or average news sentiment.
columns.name: signal_value

columns.comment: Points the trigger contributed to the 0-100 composite EWS score (0 for informational triggers).
columns.name: score_points

columns.comment: True for DPD_15, DPD_30 and NEWS_NEGATIVE: reported as signals but not part of the composite score.
columns.name: is_informational

columns.comment: Engine explanation of the firing, e.g. Utilisation 97% of committed limit.
columns.name: evidence_text

columns.comment: Client's drawn lending exposure at the signal month-end, USD (repeats on each trigger row of the client-month: do not sum across triggers).
columns.name: exposure_drawn_usd

columns.comment: Client's committed facility limits at the signal month-end, USD (repeats per trigger row).
columns.name: exposure_limit_usd

columns.comment: Distinct triggers that fired for the client in the same month.
columns.name: n_triggers_client_month

columns.comment: True when the client had both a deposit-outflow trigger (DEPOSIT_OUTFLOW / _SEVERE) and a utilisation trigger (UTIL_HIGH / UTIL_ELEVATED) in the same month.
columns.name: outflow_and_util_same_month

columns.comment: True when an internal-rating downgrade of the client followed within 90 days after the signal date (signal -> downgrade pair); use to rank which signals precede downgrades.
columns.name: preceded_downgrade_90d

columns.comment: Date of the client's next internal-rating downgrade after the signal (any horizon); null if none to the as-of date.
columns.name: next_downgrade_date

columns.comment: Days from the signal date to that next downgrade.
columns.name: days_to_next_downgrade

columns.comment: Notches of that next downgrade (positive = worse grade).
columns.name: next_downgrade_notches

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year of the signal date (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: signal_fiscal_year

columns.comment: True for signals in the current fiscal year to date (Apr-Sep 2026) - 'this fiscal year'.
columns.name: is_current_fytd

comment: Early-warning signals (brief 5.4): one row per golden client x evaluation date x EWS trigger fired, Apr-2024 to Sep-2026. The EWS engine evaluates every credit obligor monthly on month-end data, so signal_date is the month-end of the signal month (30-Sep-2026 for the current month). Carries the trigger's family, severity, source quadrant, observed value, composite-score points (0 for the informational DPD and news triggers, which do not move the score), evidence text, the client's drawn exposure at that month-end and the precomputed preceded_downgrade_90d flag (an internal-rating downgrade followed within 90 days). Trigger codes: UTIL_HIGH (utilisation >= 90%), UTIL_ELEVATED (80-90%), COV_HEADROOM_LOW (covenant headroom < 10%), COV_BREACH, DEPOSIT_OUTFLOW (>= 10% MoM), DEPOSIT_OUTFLOW_SEVERE (>= 25% MoM), WALLET_LEAKAGE, HEALTH_DECLINE, GRADE_DOWNGRADE, NEWS_NEGATIVE, DPD_15, DPD_30. Signals Fired = COUNT(*); count clients with COUNT(DISTINCT golden_client_id). Grain: one row per golden client x signal (evaluation) date x trigger code.
